changes.summary: Added deterministic health scoring, canonical/provider-relative contracts, tester-only release routes, human CS worksheet and offline rescoring, scenario tiers, and operator documentation.
Added identity-linked model-to-provider scope-chain scoring, bounded dedupe evidence, and a second reordered two-brand shorthand/typo payment case.
Added explicit environment feature expectations, authoritative unavailable-surface evidence, positive payment-option and payment-method tracked clicks, and schema-v4 baseline compatibility.

Added selectable local, commerce API, channel-read API, and metered model layers; hardened resolved endpoint allowlists, redirect rejection, response contracts, cost labels, and tracked M/H event identity.

Enforced promo provider scope after accepted composition, raised the bounded tester call ceiling to ten, and revised scenario contract 2026-09-10.2 for provider-backed promo claims, known-location progression, direct business address, and action-specific guided-surface applicability.

Revised scenario contract 2026-09-10.3 so bare store or branch-location wording asks for the customer's free-form city or area without an unsolicited head-office address or installation picker; retained an explicit head-office-address negative control.
Added an authenticated, allowlisted hydrated tester route plus a metered layered-health sentinel whose redacted usage counts toward the shared run budget.
Made provider message ID authoritative for channel-cache reuse so a new repeated phrase refreshes ManyChat history; made the protected route explicitly report its enforced return-only mode.

Enriched uniquely matched customer-authored installment scopes before provider execution and cache identity, sanitized only duplicate supporting-replacement sentences after model repair, revised scenario contract 2026-09-11.4, and made serial model execution the default semantic gate.

Normalized baseline cost at matched case/action/occurrence grain with an 80 percent coverage floor, retained unmatched aggregate workload visibility, and granted generic empty-output recovery one bounded replacement round under a one-round deployed tool budget.
Enabled one bounded main-path retry for classified transient provider failures with observable backoff and shared provider-call budget accounting; semantic failures remain non-retryable.
Added semantic business-location classification and a deterministic post-render boundary for isolated explicit-address and ambiguous-store-location goals.
Suppresses incompatible tool schemas before planning for isolated business-location goals and validates typed provider-required FAQ facts after composition while allowing natural-language variation.
Synchronizes a changed business-location boundary response into the channel renderer's preferred assistant field so rejected model prose cannot reappear after harness finalization.

Aggregates background extraction, active-memory compaction, and image evidence with main/composer usage; rejects missing component usage and unmetered retries; and exposes state-extraction and tool latency telemetry.
Adds bounded server runtime phase timings, per-phase and per-tool rollups, client-versus-handler overhead, hard missing-timing contracts, and turn-local structural duplicate scoring.

Replaces the post-lock Firestore transaction with an atomic snapshot-update-time precondition, splits state assembly from remote save timing, and supplies deterministic in-process promo-surface latency.
Restores the transaction after an exact matched staging run showed no persistence improvement; retains split persistence timing and deterministic in-process promo-surface latency.

Adds content-free transaction attempt, read, body, commit-overhead, outcome, and slow-or-failed payload-size diagnostics to the existing Firestore CAS path plus a guarded isolated paired benchmark runner.

Preserves Firestore transaction and retry behavior while observing each begin and commit RPC attempt, process context, and retry-backoff remainder; adds an authenticated staging-only generated-data no-model probe and a Cloud Build Gunicorn worker substitution.

Adds an isolated staging-only comparison of runtime-shaped nested map, canonical JSON, and gzip JSON state through unchanged CAS semantics with rotating order, exact readback, stale-revision controls, and verified cleanup.

Adds a dual legacy/canonical reader, hash-validated canonical JSON storage, configuration-selected writer, atomic opposite-representation deletion, bounded decode diagnostics, and a bidirectional deployed-format transition canary.

Aggregates content-free usage across every returned background-extraction attempt, preserves missing usage for exception-only calls, and removes the production product fallback domain in favor of normalized signal/ref selection plus bounded request_capability recovery.
Adds latest-customer canonical promo-alternative scope, provider-issued primary and alternative evidence, renderability guards, and relation-aware deferral of confirmed future payment preferences.

claims.summary: The evaluator implementation passes focused, Runtime V7, and full-repository local tests.

The transport observer and staging-only no-model probe pass 74 focused and 1786 full-repository tests. Local Firestore measured 40 KB at 314/333 ms and 140 KB at 452/455 ms p50/p95 with one successful commit per save; Cloud Run A/B remains pending.

The local 40 KiB runtime-shaped representation probe passed exact round trips, revision progression, stale-CAS rejection, and cleanup. Nested map, canonical JSON, and gzip JSON measured approximately 362, 220, and 162 ms p50 end-to-end; exact Cloud Run staging comparison remains pending.

Exact 90173d2 staging comparison proves scalar state bypasses the Firestore encoding and GC pathology: 40 KiB nested versus canonical JSON p50 save was 6637 versus 58 ms, and 140 KiB was 18626 versus 91 ms, with all CAS and cleanup controls passing. Production representation remains unchanged.

The compatibility bridge passes both generated real-Firestore migration directions locally, including pre-switch dual read, exact post-switch representation, stale-CAS no-mutation, configured non-CAS creation, and cleanup. Staging Release A and Release B remain required.

Exact 6458fd6 staging Release A passed dual reading and canonical-to-nested rollback transition with one authoritative representation, stale-CAS no-mutation, non-CAS creation, exact cleanup, and unchanged safety settings.

Exact 6458fd6 staging Release B passed the inverse nested-to-canonical transition, raw authoritative-shape checks, stale-CAS no-mutation, non-CAS creation, cleanup, identity, and safety checks; canonical persistence removed the observed multi-second save tail.

Live Cloud Run and VM promotion remain blocked despite 19 of 19 mechanical and 133 of 133 structural CS checks passing. Matrix usage exceeded the ceiling by 9655 reported tokens, two retry attempts were unmetered, and the available exact-live baseline has an incompatible timeout profile.

The retry-metering and signal-driven production projection correction passes post-review edge hardening, all 1813 repository tests, Ruff, compilation, Cloud Build YAML parsing, strict audit, and the no-cost evaluator profile. Deployed token, retry, and customer-path behavior remain pending.
Staging candidate 5b227d8 passed the three-case diagnostic model smoke with complete technical telemetry and automated CS structural checks.
Staging 0e990e7 passed exact core health, five read-only commerce API contracts, and all targeted customer-correctness paths with zero observed HTTP, runtime, or tool errors.

Live and VM promotion remain blocked. Exact staging ffde9fe passed 19 of 19 mechanical contracts but exceeded the 95000 ms p95 limit by 341 ms, and its aggregate omitted paid supplemental model calls. The complete telemetry correction must deploy and pass a fresh exact-target gate.

The local contract now separates ambiguous store-location clarification, explicit Gulong.PH or head-office address, and explicit installation or service-area requests; deployed model behavior has not yet been tested.
Current Secret Manager-backed ManyChat message-history and profile reads passed for synthetic account 4843256405786522; the new protected route still requires deployed staging verification.
Exact staging ffde9fe passed both location regressions and all 19 complete mechanical scenarios with zero HTTP, runtime, or tool errors; promotion remained blocked at 95341 ms p95.

Fresh ManyChat history reads are authenticated and paginated, but new 20:48-20:55 activity contained only field/rule events; the latest actual inbound under subscriber 4843256405786522 remains 12:16:03.

Exact staging 1f9715a passed a three-path telemetry diagnostic, but seven responses used 926358 tokens and retained 27-40 seconds beyond measured model and tool latency. A phase-instrumented targeted rerun is required before another complete matrix or promotion.

Exact staging 3479955 localized p50/p95 session persistence to 29460/31908 ms in a six-response diagnostic. The schedule case passed; the journey had one composer fallback and two deterministic promo-surface timing gaps. Conditional session-save hardening requires exact-staging verification.

Exact staging e047694 passed both matched selected paths and all structural CS checks, but conditional writes did not improve remote save latency. The experiment is reverted; complete promotion remains blocked pending storage-safe latency work and a full green gate.

A paired isolated 141 KB benchmark measured about 0.2 seconds absolute benefit from recursively exempting strategy_state indexes under maximal nested churn. Index fan-out is measurable but cannot explain the 20-35 second staging saves; compact or delta persistence is deferred pending deployed transaction-attempt diagnostics.

Exact staging 5cca58d completed the frozen matrix at 18 of 19 mechanical cases and 96.24 percent structural-CS proxy with zero operational errors. One explicit promo-alternative request omitted the gallery, and total usage exceeded the 2000000-token ceiling by 44679.

The generalized promo-alternative and future-payment deferral patch passes all 1829 repository tests, Ruff, compilation, diff checks, and the deterministic no-cost evaluator. Exact staging behavior and token margin remain pending.

Exact staging 1df9264 passed both affected mechanical scenarios with zero operational or telemetry errors. The partial diagnostic used 203926 tokens and 51793 ms p95; rendered review found one future-tense sentence inconsistent with the already-shown promo card.

The campaign-only presentation correction passes its renderable positive and invalid-surface negative controls, 28 focused commercial tests, and all 1830 repository tests. Rebuilt targeted staging verification remains pending.
